newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish companies see brighter economy - govt poll.
newsitem.headline: Swedish companies see brighter economy - govt poll.

text.p: The Swedish National Economic Research Institute (KI) said on Thursday the nation's economy had strengthened in the past few months, according to its survey of Swedish companies in August.
"Both order intake and production volume is reported to have increased," said KI, a government economic think-tank.
KI said growth came primarily from exports, with about one-third of companies surveyed reporting rising export orders.
"Put together, the order situation has improved somewhat, but a significant number of companies are reporting that order backlogs are still too small," KI said.
Industrial companies were optimistic about the coming months, it said.
One in four were planning to lift production volumes while sales prices were seen staying at about the same levels.
But KI said the building industry has stagnated in the past few months and no improvement was expected.
"Building and employment is expected to decrease along with the stock of accepted tenders," KI said. "Companies whose main business activity was construction were most pessimistic."
The foods industry reported increased sales and forecast increased volumes in the coming months.
